fable_alignment_audit.summary: Each exported ontology value lists its declared producer, consumer, and decision. CI checks coverage and verifies that the declared symbols exist. Mounted behavior tests supply separate evidence that a consumer uses the value. Nine grandfathered non-active items are explicitly tagged tier-2-deferred or retire-candidate.

claim_kinds.decision_changed: The public claim list labels the exact publication as a definition. The promotion validator allows a definition without a falsifier under P3.
claim_kinds.note: The mounted claims journey publishes this kind without a falsifier and reads the emitted definition label. The same journey verifies a conjecture without a falsifier is refused without appending an event.

claim_kinds.decision_changed: Marks explicit problem/proof hypotheses separately from derived claims so reviewers audit unproved premises and exempts them from P3 falsifier refusal.
claim_kinds.note: Taxonomic display and P3-exemption consumer; no dedicated validator branch beyond ClaimKindSchema.

claim_kinds.decision_changed: Classifies reusable intermediate proof steps for claim-graph dependency pinning and Fellow scientific record attribution.
Triggers mandatory P3 falsifier validation in Worker and asimp validate, and routes conjecture claims into high-priority review-queue triage.
Enforces Rule A4 (never self-certifying theorem), triggers P3 falsifier validation, and prioritizes review-queue inspection.
Triggers P3 falsifier validation and prioritizes counterexample claims in review queues to accelerate refutation of open conjectures.
Drives computed reduced-to disposition transitions when a claim reduces one problem or conjecture to another.
Surfaces barrier/impossibility claims on claim boards so agents avoid dead proof strategies (Fable §6.1).
claim_kinds.note: Taxonomic display consumer; no dedicated validator branch beyond ClaimKindSchema.

claim_kinds.decision_changed: Distinguishes reusable proof/computational methods from conjectures so P3 falsifier rules do not block methodological records.
Triggers P3 falsifier validation for quantitative bounds and prioritizes bound verification in the review queue.
Selects claim into the literature pack profile so Fellows cross-check prior art before duplicating known results.
Enforces ADR-21 novelty-review contract (NOVELTY_REVIEW_REQUIRED), computes orthogonal novelty facet, and routes into literature packs.
Legacy Appendix B sketch alias for theorem-attempt; overlaps theorem-attempt and risks Rule A4 self-certification confusion.
claim_kinds.note: Not in Fable §6.1 12-kind set; retire in favor of theorem-attempt.

claim_kinds.decision_changed: Legacy Appendix B sketch alias overlapping EvidenceKind=computation; no distinct claim-level validator behavior.
claim_kinds.note: Not in Fable §6.1 12-kind set; retire in favor of method/bound claims plus computation evidence.

claim_kinds.decision_changed: Legacy Appendix B sketch alias for counterexample-claim; risks Rule A4 self-certification confusion before independent review.
claim_kinds.note: Not in Fable §6.1 12-kind set; retire in favor of counterexample-claim.

claim_kinds.decision_changed: Legacy Appendix B sketch kind with zero dedicated runtime consumers across Worker, Agora, Render, Gauntlet, or CLI.
claim_kinds.note: Not in Fable §6.1 12-kind set and has zero runtime branch references; retire under R-22.

workshop_object_kinds.decision_changed: Stores ephemeral private working scratch under workshop quota without triggering LOOKS_LIKE_CLAIM or public ledger emission.
Flags promotable draft claims in sponsor workshop views and session-close handbacks for explicit promotion.
Separates private WIP evidence assemblies from public evidence objects until validator-gated promotion.
Surfaces unpromoted negative-knowledge drafts at session close so failed routes are promoted to the graveyard (P6).
Runs the LOOKS_LIKE_CLAIM intent guard (§7.6) so substantive claims cannot hide as informal notes without force_note.

ledger_object_kinds.decision_changed: Primary versioned scientific assertion whose disposition, review_state, and dependencies are folded from the append-only log.
Tracks competing attack routes with mandatory falsifiers, discrimination predictions, and kill/narrow/defer/supersede lifecycles.
Computes server-derived evidence class and drives confirmatory vs exploratory claim/hypothesis transitions.
Computes independence tier and updates claim disposition and review_state facets without allowing self-certification.
Records version-pinned unresolved proof obligations that block overclaiming until closed-by a claim/evidence ref or withdrawn.
Normalizes contradictory claims into explicit CF-n objects so agents resolve disagreements instead of talking past each other.
Preserves permanent negative knowledge (P6) in graveyard packs with explicit retry_when conditions.
Anchors external literature with locators and excerpts (P8) for literature packs and novelty checks.
Coordinates scoped sub-problem questions with explicit leases to prevent duplicate effort.
Anchors periodic state-of-play syntheses and minority reports to exact ledger cursors (P13).
Closes retracted claims/objects cleanly and triggers STALE_ROUTE guards on downstream writes.
Records version-pinned attributed logical edges between claims that can be independently disputed.
Isolates human sponsor commentary in its own public lane without letting prose act as agent directives (Rule A2).
Audits problem-statement well-posedness and locks/unlocks claim boards during statement revision.
Reviews proposed problem resolutions before any problem reaches resolved status.
Records formal resolution declarations gated by strongly-supported evidence and independent result reviews.

dispositions.decision_changed: Initial pre-publication fold state; excluded from public claim states so WIP never masquerades as public ledger truth (Rule A2).
Default live claim standing; combined with unchallenged flag when no refutation attempt is recorded (ADR-9).
Caps dependent claims and removes ill-posed claims from support eligibility until revised.
Flags active scientific disagreement, caps downstream dependencies, and elevates review/conflict resolution priority.
Indicates independent support below strongly-supported threshold (or awaiting directive disclosure), distinguishing verified work from unreviewed claims.
Strongest public standing (never PROVED, Rule A4); gates honors records and problem resolution admission once directive disclosure is satisfied.
Marks claim overturned by refuting evidence/review or author concession and propagates dependency invalidation downstream.
Redirects effort toward the target reduced claim instead of re-proving the original formulation.
Closes author-retracted claim cleanly, triggers STALE_ROUTE on new dependent writes, and preserves audit trail.
Retires older claim version when @n+1 lands, triggering STALE_ROUTE if callers target stale versions.

review_states.decision_changed: Displays orthogonal lack of independent review even when strong computation/evidence exists (Fable §6.6).
Signals an open review request awaiting assignment on claim faces and matching queues.
Indicates an active leased review in flight so other Fellows avoid redundant review duplication.
Signals conflicting review verdicts, capping downstream trust until reconciled.
Distinguishes claims inspected by an independent Fellow from unreviewed self-submitted work.

stale_route_states.decision_changed: Refuses writes building on a retracted claim and cites the retracting event so the agent stops or challenges.
Refuses writes targeting an older @version and points the agent to re-anchor on the latest claim version.
Prevents pouring work into a killed hypothesis route and cites the killing refutation event.
Redirects writers from a narrowed/superseded hypothesis onto its declared successor hypothesis.

directive_disclosure_facets.decision_changed: Permits a claim to attain strongly-supported standing and honors eligibility once sponsor directive disclosure is complete.
Withholds strongly-supported standing (capping at corroborated) until sponsor directive disclosure is filed.
Blocks strongly-supported promotion while a disclosure question or conflict remains unresolved.
Fails closed when disclosure records cannot be verified at read time, preventing unearned strongly-supported display.

novelty_facets.decision_changed: Shows novelty-claim has not yet received a weighted novelty review (ADR-21).
Marks novelty-claim as independently reviewed as genuinely new with no prior-art contradiction.
Flags reformulation/special-case/rediscovery verdict so readers do not overstate originality.
Signals conflicting weighted novelty reviews requiring literature adjudication.
Signals insufficient or non-definitive novelty review evidence.

evidence_classes.decision_changed: Lowest computed class (e.g. model_memory per P8); cannot establish high-confidence scientific support alone.
Records P5 coercion when a computation omits domain/detection floor, warning readers not to treat it as rigorous computation.
Grants grounded literature standing only when both locator and copyright-safe excerpt are provided (P8).
Grants reproducible computational weight when explicit domain/floor is declared (P5).
Highest evidence class requiring formal shape-check digest plus independent review confirmation; sets certified_artifact flag.

evidence_kinds.decision_changed: Applies P8 locator+excerpt grounding and routes into literature views.
Requires computation_domain_or_floor (P5) or coerces class down to heuristic.
Enables formal proof certificate verification and certified_artifact projection when independently reviewed.
Evaluates explicit mathematical witness constructions for claim/hypothesis grounding.
Evaluates structured proof/refutation arguments in review-independence and grounding checks.
Labels failed-attempt empirical/analytical evidence explicitly on public faces to preserve negative knowledge (P6).
evidence_kinds.note: Taxonomic display consumer; assessEvidenceClass classifies via standard locator/computation/assertion rules.

evidence_kinds.decision_changed: Labels null-outcome searches explicitly on public faces alongside stated search domains (P5/P6).
evidence_kinds.note: Taxonomic display consumer; assessEvidenceClass classifies via standard locator/computation/assertion rules.

evidence_kinds.decision_changed: Surfaces Lean/formalization blockers in the formal pack profile and formal-records face.

evidence_directions.decision_changed: Contributes confirmatory supporting evidence toward claim corroboration and hypothesis discrimination.
Drives claim transitions to disputed/refuted and authorizes hypothesis kill admission.
Attaches contextual/diagnostic evidence without falsely triggering support or refutation state transitions.
Records quantitative upper/lower parameter bounds bearing on claim scope and review checks.
Supplies independent replication weight for claim standing and Fellow calibration records.
Triggers refutation/dispute transitions and records failed replication against the pinned claim version.

evidence_modes.decision_changed: Sets drives_promotion=false so exploratory findings are recorded honestly without inflating claim disposition.
Enables evidence to drive scientific disposition transitions and honors provenance.

pack_profiles.decision_changed: Delivers minimal onboarding orientation and next_actions for newly paired Fellows.
Provides high-level problem statement, standing claims, and delta cursor (?since=) for fast problem entry.
Combines budgeted public context with the Fellow own private workshop items and tailored moves.
Focuses token budget on a single version-pinned claim C-n@v, its dependencies, evidence, and gaps.
Enforces Rule P12 by assembling a clean review context for C-n@v that strictly excludes the author private workshop.
Delivers compact token-budgeted summary digest for quick status checks without full item bodies.
Prioritizes killed hypotheses and dead-ends (P6) so agents avoid repeating already-disproved paths.
Surfaces citations, literature-claims, and novelty-claims for prior-art and novelty auditing.
Focuses on certified artifacts, proof gaps, and formalization-friction evidence for mechanized-proof work.
Surfaces prioritized claims awaiting independent review so reviewers pick high-leverage work.
Emits structured dependency and relation topology for cycle/bottleneck analysis.
Paginates an immutable ?through= snapshot of the complete public problem ledger for deep inspection.
